candidates.change_summary: Remove the onlyAdmin modifier from setOwner, allowing any caller to change the owner.
Change owner assignment to a constant address, so owner is set to that constant regardless of _owner argument.
Assign _owner to a different state variable (e.g., admin) instead of owner, leaving owner unchanged.
Delete the assignment statement inside setOwner so owner is never updated.
Replace the require check in onlyAdmin with a condition that always passes, letting anyone bypass the admin restriction.
Change the require check to compare against a different immutable address, preventing the real admin from calling and possibly allowing a pre-set attacker.
Change the function to set owner to msg.sender instead of the parameter _owner.
Replace `return true;` with `return false;` so setOwner always returns false on success instead of true.
Replace `owner = _owner;` with `owner = address(0);` so the storage update is independent of the argument.
Delete the `onlyAdmin` modifier from `setOwner` so anyone can change the owner.
Delete the entire `require` statement in the modifier, removing the admin check.
